# aw

> AI Agentic Workflows for data preparation and transformation


## Pages in this subsection

- [aw](aw.html.md): aw - Agentic Workflows for Data Preparation
- [aw.base](aw.base.html.md): Core protocols and base classes for agentic workflows.
- [aw.cosmo](aw.cosmo.html.md): Cosmograph-specific validator tool.
- [aw.func_calling](aw.func_calling.html.md): This module provides robust templates for creating (python) code-generating functions
- [aw.loading](aw.loading.html.md): Loading agent for converting data sources to pandas DataFrames.
- [aw.orchestration](aw.orchestration.html.md): Orchestration and workflow management for agentic steps.
- [aw.preparing](aw.preparing.html.md): Preparation agent for transforming data to meet target requirements.
- [aw.py_gen](aw.py_gen.html.md): Function makeing and calling
- [aw.routing](aw.routing.html.md): Configurable routing and decision chains for agentic workflows.
- [aw.tools](aw.tools.html.md): Tools for executing code and other agent actions.
- [aw.translators](aw.translators.html.md): Translators from aw agent specifications to other agent formats.
- [aw.util](aw.util.html.md): Utility tools and helper functions for agents.
- [aw.validation](aw.validation.html.md): Validation system supporting three flavors: schema, info-dict, and functional.
